name: b1-noreceive
js: (() => { const T = window.CITY.TSL; const a = window.__CITY_APP; const ms = []; a.scene.traverse((m) => { if (m.isMesh && /^HippedRoofs/.test(m.name)) ms.push(m); }); const mat = ms[0].material; mat.colorNode = T.vec3(0.3, 0.3, 0.3); for (const m of ms) m.receiveShadow = false; mat.needsUpdate = true; return ms.length; })()

name: b2-noreceive-noao
js: (() => { const T = window.CITY.TSL; const a = window.__CITY_APP; const ms = []; a.scene.traverse((m) => { if (m.isMesh && /^HippedRoofs/.test(m.name)) ms.push(m); }); const mat = ms[0].material; mat.colorNode = T.vec3(0.3, 0.3, 0.3); for (const m of ms) m.receiveShadow = false; mat.aoNode = T.float(1); mat.needsUpdate = true; return ms.length; })()

name: b3-emissive
js: (() => { const T = window.CITY.TSL; const a = window.__CITY_APP; const ms = []; a.scene.traverse((m) => { if (m.isMesh && /^HippedRoofs/.test(m.name)) ms.push(m); }); const mat = ms[0].material; mat.colorNode = T.vec3(0.3, 0.3, 0.3); mat.emissiveNode = T.vec3(0.2, 0.0, 0.0); mat.needsUpdate = true; return ms.length; })()

name: b4-normalup
js: (() => { const T = window.CITY.TSL; const a = window.__CITY_APP; const ms = []; a.scene.traverse((m) => { if (m.isMesh && /^HippedRoofs/.test(m.name)) ms.push(m); }); const mat = ms[0].material; mat.colorNode = T.vec3(0.3, 0.3, 0.3); mat.emissiveNode = null; mat.normalNode = T.vec3(0, 1, 0); mat.needsUpdate = true; return ms.length; })()
